## A practical starting point

LIB002 is a self-paced learning resource developed by SMU Libraries. It introduces essential research practices and points you towards useful tools, resources and specialist support.

It is not a comprehensive research methods course. Think of it as a welcoming front door: use it to orient yourself, strengthen a particular skill, or find the next source of help.
:::

::: {#modules .content-band}
<p class="eyebrow">Five interactive books</p>

## How to use LIB002

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-item}
### Choose what you need

Each module stands on its own. Begin with a current question or explore all five over time.
:::

::: {.feature-item}
### Learn interactively

Every module contains an embedded H5P Interactive Book. A direct link is also provided if the book does not load.
:::

::: {.feature-item}
### Return as you progress

Bookmark individual module pages and revisit them at different stages of your research.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.support-panel__content}
